title: Chapter 223
content:
Chapter 223

This time the two sides were able to achieve such a result. In addition to each paying some elite soldiers to lead the ordinary soldiers, and killing an momentum, there was also their own persecution, so that the soldiers knew in their hearts that they had no way out.

Therefore, it is possible to play a casualty ratio that can only be played by elite aces. The casualties of both sides are close to 80%, and Yuguo has reached more than 80%.

This kind of strong will not to give orders and never stop fighting, not only made Qin feel a sense of deterrence, but also made Han and Yan countries behind Yu state feel fear.

Even if they are members of the Alliance, they belong to the alliance with the country of this army and are current comrades-in-arms.

But for the kings of their respective countries, they have to think deeply about how they will deal with this leader and the relationship between the two countries in the future?

No one wants to be subservient to others all the time. The two countries, as the most deeply influenced and most powerfully controlled by the Imperial Kingdom, are naturally looking for ways to get rid of it.

But now, the bravery of the imperial army and the spirit of not fearing life and death made them feel intimidated. They couldn't help thinking, if they faced this kind of army by themselves, what kind of situation could they do?

The answer at least made them each feel terrified, and the thoughts in their hearts were slowly extinguished.

All in all, no matter what they think in their hearts, this first battle is slowly coming to an end.

With the withdrawal of the respective armies of both sides, only some soldiers left by both sides were cleaning the corpses on the battlefield. Other than that, there were ferocious beasts running out for food and vultures and flies in the sky.

...

Time passed quickly, and in the blink of an eye, it was the second month, the eve before the start of the second decisive battle.

At this moment, in a remote tent in the big camp of Yan State, several Yan State soldiers were whispering.

"Brother, it's our turn to go to the battlefield tomorrow. Tell me, do you think we can survive?" A thin Yan soldier asked the burly man in front of him with a little panic in his tone. .

"Gang, you have to remember, as a man from the Yan Kingdom, you won't be afraid of such things!" The bald man in front of him, with only a tuft of hair on his back, patted the shoulder of the thin soldier in front of him, sighing. Said loudly.

"However, you also saw the battle last month, brother, how many of those Yuguo barbarians came back after going to the battlefield..." The soldier named Ah Gang's tone was a little low.

It's not his fault, it was the first battle between Yu Kingdom and Qin Kingdom, and the brutality scared them.

A full 80% of the casualties, out of ten people, only one or two can survive in the end. No wonder they feel scared. With this casualty ratio, everyone has no idea whether they can survive to the end.

This is what Ah Gang thinks now, he has already regarded this last night as the last peaceful and peaceful day he has enjoyed, and cherishes it very much.

"What are you afraid of? As soldiers, it is our duty to die in battle. Could it be that our Yan soldiers are not as good as a barbarian in the north? Besides, as your eldest brother, I will protect you and will definitely lead you to live." To the last peaceful and prosperous world!" The big hammer held Ah Gang's face with both hands, lifted him up, pierced the somewhat confused eyes with piercing eyes, and said solemnly.

"Brother..." Looking at the eyes of the big iron hammer, Ah Gang seemed to have realized something, and tears rolled in his eyes.

...

The next day, this day is the beginning of the second decisive battle. As the main force of the decisive battle, the 100,000 people from Yan State and the 50,000 people from South Korea will all be on the field. In addition to the 50,000 Huns on the imperial side, the total army is 200,000, which is already more than 2/3 of the coalition forces.

Those who stayed in the rear and supervised the battlefield were the only ones who had encountered the remaining 50,000 elite soldiers and the 15,000 remnants who had retreated and were still recuperating.

The Qin army on the opposite side also has 200,000 people, but their composition is much better than that on the opposite side. They are all the elites of Qin who have been on the battlefield for a long time. pride.

In this way, one is united and self-confident, and the other has a complicated composition and different thoughts. The battles between them will naturally be very interesting.

The war has just begun, and with another thunder of the war drum, the respective soldiers are divided into batches, and batch after batch go to the predetermined location to fight the enemy.

Qin State is worthy of being Qin State, and it still has his ability to crush the six countries, even if it is now in decline.

As soon as the battle was fought, Qin's fearless and brave soldiers opened several breakthroughs, rushed to the tens of thousands of soldiers who had just gone up, and beat them into cripples.

Among them, Li Xin, the general who had recently gained fame due to the state of Qin, performed most prominently.

He led 10,000 cavalry of the Qin Army, dashing left and right on the battlefield. He had a very good grasp of the timing, and he could often find the weakness of the coalition forces, and then rushed past, and a part of the battlefield was defeated.

"Who is that man? He is so brave, and his intuition for war is so keen!" Looking at Li Xin's army, which was extremely eye-catching on the battlefield, Zhong Yu pointed at him and asked the people around him.

"Reporting to Your Majesty, this is Li Xin, a young general who has recently risen from the Qin State. He is brave and good at fighting. He is only about 20 years old, but he has already reached the position of general of the Qin State, and he is in command of an all-powerful elite cavalry of the Qin State. At that moment, he led 3,000 men to defeat an army of tens of thousands in the Zhao State, and then went to war in the south and north, and he was outstanding among the many generals in the Qin State, so he was promoted to his current position!" A minister beside him told him what he knew The information came out.

"It turned out to be Li Xin. No wonder he has this ability. It's too much to destroy our army's prestige. Who can defeat him?" Hearing the name Li Xin, Zhong Yu made clear points Nodding his head, he understood why this young general was so brave.

As an extremely prominent general in the war to unify the world in the late Qin Dynasty, Li Xin's performance can be said to be extremely outstanding among the younger generation.

He even overwhelmed the prestige of Meng Tian and others, and was almost on par with Wang Jian. What he was short of was just the precipitation of time. It was a pity that in the battle of destroying Chu, the long-term victory made him start to swell. He arrogantly said that 200,000 troops would be enough. To destroy Chu, they actually regarded Chu as a weak country like Han, Zhao and Wei.

In the end, he failed miserably and was relegated to Longxi by the King of Qin. He became an unknown frontier general with no future.

Hearing Zhong Yu's words, several generals nearby looked at each other for a few times, but finally they didn't dare to make a sound and just lowered their heads.

Seeing the cowardly performance of these generals in front of him, Zhong Yu became angry for a while, are these the generals of the Six Kingdoms? No wonder he was so incompetent and was repeatedly defeated by Qin.
